title: Stage of equality for descended quasi-compact opens
statement:
Fix the base-changed system of [def-nagata-basechanged-system] with $\lambda_0\in I$. Assume that $I$ is directed, $S=\varprojlim_\lambda S_\lambda$, every transition $S_\mu	o S_\lambda$ is affine, and $Y_{\lambda_0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated (as a scheme; this holds when $S_{\lambda_0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $Y_{\lambda_0}	o S_{\lambda_0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, e.g. $S_{\lambda_0}$ of finite type over $\mathbf Z$). Let $W_{1,\lambda_0},W_{2,\lambda_0}\subseteq Y_{\lambda_0}$ be quasi-compact opens whose inverse images in $Y$ agree. Choose a finite affine cover $Y_{\lambda_0}= igcup_k U_k$ and write $U_{k,\lambda}$ for its inverse image in $Y_\lambda$ and $U_k^\infty$ for its inverse image in $Y$. Using quasi-separatedness, choose finite presentations $W_{i,\lambda_0}\cap U_k= igcup_jD(f_{ijk})$ with $f_{ijk}\in\Gamma(U_k,\mathcal O)$, and denote their pullbacks to $\Gamma(U_k^\infty,\mathcal O)$ by $ ar f_{ijk}$. Equality of the two inverse-image opens gives the radical containments $ ar f_{1jk}\in\sqrt{( ar f_{2\ell k})_\ell}$ and $ ar f_{2jk}\in\sqrt{( ar f_{1\ell k})_\ell}$ in the limit ring. Choose witnessing identities $ ar f_{1jk}^{n_{1jk}}=\sum_\ell a_{1jk\ell} ar f_{2\ell k}$ and $ ar f_{2jk}^{n_{2jk}}=\sum_\ell a_{2jk\ell} ar f_{1\ell k}$, with finitely many coefficients. By [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition] and [lem-weil-pbc-limit-global-sections-colimit] (Stacks Tags 01YW/01Z0), $\Gamma(U_k^\infty,\mathcal O)\cong\varinjlim_{\lambda\geq\lambda_0}\Gamma(U_{k,\lambda},\mathcal O)$. Write $f_{ijk,\lambda}\in\Gamma(U_{k,\lambda},\mathcal O)$ for the pullback of $f_{ijk}$ (so its image in $\Gamma(U_k^\infty,\mathcal O)$ is $ ar f_{ijk}$). For each $k$, apply [lemma-nagata-filtered-colimit-finite-data] to the directed system $(\Gamma(U_{k,\lambda},\mathcal O))_{\lambda\geq\lambda_0}$ and the finitely many coefficients $a_{ijk\ell}$ (no equalities) to select a stage $\mu_k\geq\lambda_0$ and lifts $a_{ijk\ell,\mu_k}\in\Gamma(U_{k,\mu_k},\mathcal O)$. For each witnessing identity, the element $f_{1jk,\mu_k}^{n_{1jk}}-\sum_\ell a_{1jk\ell,\mu_k}f_{2\ell k,\mu_k}$ (resp. $f_{2jk,\mu_k}^{n_{2jk}}-\sum_\ell a_{2jk\ell,\mu_k}f_{1\ell k,\mu_k}$) maps to $0$ in $\Gamma(U_k^\infty,\mathcal O)$, so by the injectivity clause of [lem-weil-pbc-limit-global-sections-colimit] select a stage $
u\geq\mu_k$ at which its image in $\Gamma(U_{k,
u},\mathcal O)$ is $0$, i.e. the identity holds there with the actual pullbacks $f_{ijk,
u}$ and the transported coefficients. Let $F$ be the finite set consisting of $\lambda_0$, the $\mu_k$ and these finitely many witness stages $
u$, and define $\lambda_{W_1=W_2}:=u(F)$ using [def-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound]. (At any $\lambda$ above every element of $F$ the transported identities give $D(f_{1jk,\lambda})\subseteq igcup_\ell D(f_{2\ell k,\lambda})$ and conversely in $U_{k,\lambda}$, which is what the eventual-equality lemma for these opens uses.)

split_report.summary: Repaired the definition after return E7: the statement now assumes the qcqs base scheme and affine transitions required for finite affine charts and the affine global-sections colimit, introduces the base-changed system dependency, specifies both chartwise radical containments and their witnessing power identities with coefficients, applies finite-data descent to obtain the finite witness-stage set, and then applies the selected finite upper bound.
